page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, providing a total of 32 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94489 GB of HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The reliance on HDD storage instead of solid-state drives presents a clear tradeoff, offering vast capacity at the expense of random IOPS and access latency. Consequently, this server is designed for workloads that require sequential data access and high storage density rather than rapid random read/write operations. Appropriate workloads include big data analytics, distributed file systems, large-scale data warehousing, and cold storage archiving.
